title: Playful Little Boys in Cardboard Boxes, 1947 Americana B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A charming postwar snapshot featuring two joyful young boys, identified as Bobby and Jim, sitting inside repurposed cardboard product crates on a sunny lawn. The boy on the left cradles a fluffy stuffed animal while nestled inside a Henry K. Wampole & Co. stimulant tonic box, while his brother beams happily from an oversized Model Smoking Tobacco box. Captured on May 7, 1947, beside a white wood-sided house, the image reflects the simple pleasures, family warmth, and imaginative play characteristic of mid-20th-century American childhood.
